description: Freeze Terraform provider versions across 30 Terraform-managed stacks. Must: inventory all provider versions in use, pin provider versions in lock files, validate that pinned versions produce identical plans (terraform plan), test apply in staging, and roll out version-pinned providers to production. Risk factors: provider version pin breaking on new resources, state file incompatibility between versions, plan diff from provider behavior changes. Tools available: terraform, tfenv, aws CLI, GitHub Actions.
